subject: Re: MAP — security acceptance checklist and retention delegation
messages:
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@heliosbank.com>
To: dev_patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: MAP kickoff — security acceptance and retention questions

Hi Dev,

Thanks for the demo this morning. Our team is drafting the mutual action plan and a couple of items bubbled up from Legal and InfoSec that I wanted to get on the record early:  

1) SOC 2 report cadence — we need confirmation of the next available full SOC 2 Type II report and whether Redwood will provide a bridge letter for anything older than 12 months.
2) SIG/CAIQ — our cloud security team wants the completed CAIQ workbook and timeline for delivery (we prefer within the MAP close window).
3) DPA redlines — our GC has circulated edits; we can send a redlined PDF. Primary ask is clarity on data retention and deletion controls for embeddings and logs.

We are aiming to finish the MAP and have Legal sign by June 10 to support a July production target. Can you confirm who on your side will own the evidence intake and what the expected turnaround is for each artifact?

Attached: SOC2-request-template.xlsx (stub)

Thanks,
Maria Lopez
Head of Cloud Risk — Helios Bank
Maria.Lopez@heliosbank.com

--
Helios Bank

From: dev_patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@heliosbank.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 16:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — security acceptance and retention questions

Maria — thanks for the notes and for outlining the MAP timeline. Quick answers below and a proposed intake plan attached.

SOC 2: Redwood has a 2026 Type II report (attached as SOC2-report-2026.pdf). We can provide a bridge letter for any controls that have changed since the report date; Kimberly will coordinate the specifics.

SIG/CAIQ: We maintain a populated CAIQ; Kimberly will share the current workbook and propose a delivery date (target within 5 business days).

DPA / retention: We can accept the redlines and propose standard language for embeddings and ephemeral logs. High level: embeddings derived from customer content are retained for 90 days by default for cache efficiency; we offer configurable retention windows down to 0 days for customers with regulatory constraints, and we support deletion-on-demand with attestation. Details and options are in the attached MAP draft.

Owner & turnaround:
- Evidence intake owner: Kimberly Park (kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com) — she will be the point for SOC2/SIG/DPA artifacts.
- Turnaround: SOC2 report and bridge letter — 2 business days after request; CAIQ workbook — 3 business days; DPA redline response — 3 business days.

I've attached: MAP-Helios-v1.xlsx (proposed MAP with milestones), SOC2-report-2026.pdf (stub).

Proposed next step: quick alignment call Monday 5/31 at 10:00 PT to walk artifacts and acceptance criteria. Does that work for your Legal + InfoSec?

Best,
Dev Patel
Solutions Lead — Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwoodinference.com

Attachment stubs: MAP-Helios-v1.xlsx, SOC2-report-2026.pdf

From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@heliosbank.com>
To: dev_patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, CFO HeliosBank <cfo@heliosbank.com>, Helios Legal <legal@heliosbank.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:04:00 +0000
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — security acceptance and retention questions

Dev / Kimberly —

Appreciate the fast turnaround on the SOC2 and MAP draft. A couple of clarifying points from Legal and InfoSec after a quick pass:  

- Retention: For regulated PII we will require a maximum retention of 30 days unless we agree to a specific exception in the annex. Can Redwood confirm support for a 30-day maximum for PII-derived embeddings?
- Deletion attestation: We will need a signed attestation when deletion-on-demand is executed, with the timeline of completion (48 hours) and scope (embeddings + request logs).
- DPA redlines: Attached is a redlined PDF (DPA-redlines-helio.pdf). Primary open items are breach notice timing and subcontractor (third-party) subprocessors list.

We are available for the Monday call; InfoSec will join with a couple of folks. If you can update the MAP milestones to reflect the 30-day retention ask and deletion attestation, that will help Legal sign off faster.

Regards,
Maria

From: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 10:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — security acceptance and retention questions

Maria — looping in from Commercial & Legal to confirm timeline and acceptance gates. Short version: we can meet Helios' asks but need to lock milestones in the MAP so Procurement has a clear close path. Proposed adjustments below.

Planned MAP milestones (updated):
- May 31: artifact review call (complete)
- June 2: Redwood to deliver CAIQ workbook + bridge letter (if requested)
- June 4: Redwood DPA response with proposed counter-language (we will accept most retention changes but need a carveout flow for embeddings used for shared model optimization)
- June 8: Helios sign-off on MAP + DPA (Legal and InfoSec acceptance)
- June 15: Operational readiness check (SRE/Onboarding runbook)

Acceptance gates: SOC 2 Type II (2026) or equivalent bridge letter; completed CAIQ; DPA with agreed retention annex (30-day max for PII by default for Helios); deletion attestation process documented and SLA for attestation within 48 hours.

Notes on subprocessors: we will produce a current subprocessors list and offer a 30-day notification window for material changes; for any restricted subprocessors Helios flags, we will propose an escrow/mitigation path.

If Legal at Helios can confirm June 8 for signature, we will coordinate Procurement and onboarding to meet your July production target.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Director, Sales Operations — Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com

From: dev_patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@heliosbank.com>, jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Helios Legal <legal@heliosbank.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 18:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — security acceptance and retention questions

All —

Great call and thanks for the clear asks. Summary of agreed items and immediate action items (so Procurement has a single source of truth):

Agreed MAP updates (I will upload a revised MAP-Helios-v1.xlsx to the shared HubSpot doc by EOD Wednesday):
- Retention: Helios default: 30 days for PII-derived embeddings. Option to extend with explicit annex and SLA.
- Deletion attestation: Redwood will provide attestation within 48 hours of deletion completion; attestation will include scope and timestamp.
- SOC 2: 2026 Type II provided; Kimberly will generate a bridge letter if InfoSec requests one.
- CAIQ: Kimberly to deliver completed CAIQ workbook by 2027-06-02.
- DPA redlines: Redwood to submit proposed counter-language by 2027-06-04 (attached DPA-redlines-helio.pdf referenced).
- Subprocessors: current list and change-notice process to be attached to the MAP (30-day notification on material changes).

Action owners & SLAs:
- Kimberly Park: CAIQ workbook, bridge letter, DPA counter-proposal (3 business days per artifact).
- Dev Patel: MAP consolidation and hub upload (EOD Wed), coordinate onboarding date.
- Jordan Blake: Procurement coordination and signature chase; he will kick off the DocuSign once Legal confirms.

Attachments referenced: MAP-Helios-v1.xlsx, DPA-redlines-helio.pdf, SOC2-report-2026.pdf (all uploaded as stubs).

Next steps: I will upload the updated MAP, add the acceptance gates as bullet items, and send the DocuSign envelope once Helios Legal confirms the final DPA. If Helios can confirm June 8 for sign-off, Redwood will prioritize onboarding resources the following week.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this.

Dev Patel
Solutions Lead — Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwoodinference.com
